title: When Less is More: Understanding When Token Filtering Helps and Fails in AI-generated Text Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.29903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has made AI-generated text detection increasingly critical. Existing zero-shot detectors assume that more token-level evidence leads to more reliable detection. However, our empirical study challenges this consensus: fewer tokens sometimes work better, retaining only 40% can yield optimal performance, yet this benefit is not universal. Using the Entropy Gap Score (EGS), we introduce top-$k$ cumulative probability filtering as a diagnostic probe. Across three representative settings, filtering exhibits strikingly different behaviors. We analyze EGS via typical set theory and quantify its dynamics through entropy calibration and distribution analysis. We find that filtering helps for weak source LMs, where low-entropy tokens are harmful, but fails for strong source LMs, where they are not notably harmful. translated_title: 少即是多：理解词元过滤在AI生成文本检测中何时有效与何时失效
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展使得AI生成文本检测变得日益重要。现有的零样本检测器假设更多的词元级证据能带来更可靠的检测效果。然而，我们的实证研究挑战了这一共识：更少的词元有时效果更好，仅保留40%的词元即可达到最佳性能，但这一收益并不具有普适性。我们利用熵差距分数（Entropy Gap Score, EGS），引入top-k累积概率过滤作为诊断探针。在三种代表性设置中，过滤表现出截然不同的行为。我们通过典型集理论对EGS进行分析，并通过熵校准和分布分析量化其动态变化。我们发现，过滤对弱源语言模型有效，因为此时低熵词元是有害的；但对强源语言模型无效，因为此时低熵词元并无明显危害。我们的工作首次提供了系统性分析，表明某些词元并非……
tldr: 该研究首次系统性地揭示了词元过滤在AI生成文本检测中的双重作用：仅保留40%的top-k累积概率词元可显著提升弱源语言模型的检测性能，但对强源语言模型无效，从而挑战了“更多词元证据带来更可靠检测”的传统假设。
en_tdlr: This work provides the first systematic analysis showing that top-k cumulative probability token filtering helps AI-generated text detection for weak source LMs—where low-entropy tokens are harmful—but fails for strong source LMs, challenging the assumption that more token-level evidence leads to more reliable detection.
